title: Nixon calls Hughes to set up a Castro assassination, as told by Trafficante

as_told.title: Nixon, Howard Hughes and the mafia set up the S Force to kill Castro
as_told.place_text: Las Vegas; Chicago; Fontainebleau Hotel, Florida

plain: A lawyer named Danny Sheehan says that Santos Trafficante, an organized crime figure, told him and his team directly how a plot came about around 1960. As Sheehan tells it, Richard Nixon called the billionaire Howard Hughes to set up the killing of Fidel Castro, the leader of Cuba, with Hughes's aide Bob Maheu, the mobsters Johnny Roselli and Sam Giancana, and Nelson Rockefeller also part of the account. If true, it would tie top US politicians and the mob together in secret operations.
